title: The Organized Thing
summary: The Oathless have coalesced at the Crossroads, eighteen former Emberguard soldiers with no charter and one shared purpose. They want to hold the Sovereigns Approach so the party can reach the Riftgate without fighting through two layers of opposition. They are asking for a plan and someone to coordinate it.

phases.label: Locate the Oathless position at the Crossroads approach

onComplete.text: Eighteen soldiers in no particular formation, well-armed, with a shared willingness to do the thing they were discharged for almost doing. Their plan has three phases and one contingency. The contingency is: if the party does not return in three days, they fall back to the Crossroads and wait for someone else.

phases.label: Coordinate the Oathless defensive position at Sovereign's Approach

onComplete.text: The position holds. The Oathless fight the same way they always did — by the training that was good, and by the judgment that got them discharged. The Ashen Veil finds the approach unexpectedly contested.

phases.label: Return to the Oathless after the final confrontation

onComplete.text: They are still there. Fourteen of eighteen, which is better than the contingency predicted. They do not ask what happened inside. They can tell from how the party looks coming back. 'Did it work?' Yes or no, they say. Then they get up and start the march back to the Crossroads.
